author: steven5703
body:
This is Unexpected battle, or a wasteland revamp, if you will.

The thing thats going around here is that this a road that cuts through a desert with a broken bridge.... and its a warzone.

Here is the the album: http://imgur.com/a/nAUNv
Click that for more detailed info on each areas.

I know the map is really huge, I'm working on making it shorter or adding more stuff to make it less plain...
I need your thoughts and ideas so we can improve the map.

People whose helped so far:
Me
MLGtino
NingaBridge
LeCobalt
alexanderjoe (built stuff and also hosted the server)
and sorry if i forgot your name a lot of people helped.

You might spawn with a pig or horse egg and a saddle btw

New screenies: http://imgur.com/a/jQPX8#1

replies.author: Pigbeard_Pete
replies.body:
It's great, so far but it looks kind empty. I get that it's supposed to be like a wasteland and all, but you can add many more geographical structures and block types in the desert beyond the compound. ATM it looks really bland and white-ish yellow, with very little block variation in terms of the landscape. Add more buildings and things, maybe a blown out diner or gas station or small townish area. Use ideas from the popular videogame Fallout which is all about this kind of stuff.

Otherwise, it looks really cool!
